english.note: Pearson 75; Cambridge 190. Exemption for qualifying citizenship or at least one year full-time university study in U.S./qualifying country ending within two years of intended admission.

applicationFee.note: International fee $80; program explicitly excludes international waivers. Biochemistry hardship waiver for U.S. citizens, permanent residents or DACA with FAFSA EFC ≤$5,500; affiliation and military waivers also offered.

documents: Personal statement addressing PhD motivation, research experience, interests and faculty fit
Unofficial transcripts from every postsecondary institution
requirements.note: Minimum undergraduate GPA 3.0. No formal coursework prerequisites; two semesters biochemistry and one semester each physical chemistry, organic chemistry, cell biology and molecular biology suggested. No lab position needed before applying.

funding.note: In general all PhD students receive stipend and tuition throughout studies; first-year TA then typically research-group RA, dependent on research-group funding. No unconditional funding guarantee or amount stated.

timeline.interviews: Virtual interview invitations roll through January after December–January review.
timeline.decisions: Rolling offers January–April; accept by April 15.
